decision.quote:
Third,  in  experiment  NS11,  an  exact  replication  of  Stern  et  al.  (2012),  freezing  scores  observed  during  the 
reactivation session were consistent with those obtained in the original paper, suggesting successful and similar 
fear acquisition. However, visual inspection of the graphs (Fig. 2 and Appendix C, Fig. C.2F) shows that SAL rats 
showed lower freezing at test compared to MDZ rats, a pattern opposite to the findings reported in the original 
paper.
decision.reason: Stern et al. (2012) is listed in Table 1 (p. 3, Lab III, Exp. 1, Fig. 1A; 3-min reactivation, 1.5 mg/kg systemic post-reactivation MDZ, N = 15, d = 1.49) and was directly retested in a dedicated preregistered exact replication (Experiment NS11; Methods 2.9.3, pp. 7-8; Results 3.2, p. 11; Fig. 2, p. 12), which found no amnestic effect of post-reactivation MDZ compared to saline (one-tailed t-test: t(10) = .57, p = .709, d = .33, BF10 = .34). It is distinct from shipped row 2487 (Alfei et al., 2015, which was replicated in NS9).
